data.name: SIMQ_PUFFER_HINWEIS_KASKADE
data.value:
Cascade (boiler): the boiler draws its inlet temperature from the selected buffer storage instead of from the system return.
Share = (storage flow − boiler return) / (boiler flow − boiler return)
The fuel demand drops by this share of the useful heat; the withdrawal is at the same time a discharge of the storage. If the storage delivers less, fuel covers the shortfall. The boiler is computed after the generator that charges the storage.

data.name: SIMERG_INFO_BHKW
data.value:
Heat-led (standard) The CHP unit follows the space heating and DHW demand. The electricity generated covers the own demand; surplus is fed into the public grid.
Electricity-led (economic) The CHP unit follows the electricity demand. Surplus heat is buffered in the storage as long as storage capacity is available; beyond that, surplus heat is dumped.
Without feed-in (zero export) The CHP unit never generates more electricity than the current own demand. The unit throttles back immediately as soon as the electricity demand is covered or the heat storage is full. No grid feed-in.
